why: PRINTED: 'At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, OR WITH YOUR HORNS UNARMED STRIKE, you get its critical specialization effect.' We covered the four weapons; the horns half reached nothing. bases matches strike.base, which for a natural attack is natural:<index> and never a slug; groups/traits would light crit spec on Fist and every other unarmed strike. New critSpecWeapons.names, read by weaponMatches (derive.ts), matches the strike NAME. The 'At 5th level' gate comes free: this record already carries critSpecLevel 5, which CritSpecSource applies.
